verdict.rationale: Sandbox or test environments are a fair question for a SaaS monitoring platform, but the evidence pack documents no sandbox, test-org, or non-production mode that isolates testing from production data. Self-hosting a separate instance (sentry-docs-28) would be a user-side workaround, and MCP org/project scoping (sentry-docs-63) is an adjacent control, so neither earns credit.
